states: Pro runtime with a dev Pro licence (Patrol modes available), alert triggers on, Critical only: the help line shows under the selector, two lines at 1440 and three at 390, inside the card, dark and light, no horizontal page overflow.
Same install, Warning and critical: no help line and no described-by on the selector.
Same install, alert triggers off: the selector and the help line are both gone. Back on: both return.
Pro runtime with no licence (This install runs Watch only), Critical only: selector shown, no help line, at 1440 and 390.
interactions: Changed the selector to Warning and critical and back with the mouse, and with ArrowDown and ArrowUp from the keyboard. The line left and returned each time.
Turned the Alert-triggered Patrols switch off and on again.
Read the selector's described-by text in the page: it is the help line. Nothing was saved by these edits (settings read back as critical).
Cleared the dev licence through the API and reloaded to reach the Watch only state.
limitations: Private mock-mode stack on pulse-dev, embedded production build, headless Chromium. No model was configured and background Patrol was off, so no sustained run happened here. The help line restates constants in internal/ai/unified/bridge.go.
The line's wording for the chosen Patrol mode is not checked: this page does not know the mode, so the line names the two modes it applies to.
Screen reader software was not used. The described-by wiring was read from the page and from the rendered test.
One of three passes timed out waiting for the page on its first light-theme load while pulse-dev load was about 13. The other two passes completed with no console errors.
